svg.title: llama.cpp: prefill and token generation
svg.desc: Three-phase means normalized to Before. Error bars show process SD divided by the fixed Before mean, not confidence intervals.
svg.text: Bars: 3 independent process means, each process containing 5 repeats; Before mean = 1×.
Whiskers: process SD / fixed Before mean. Absolute tok/s and SDs are in the CSV.
